Home.heroTitle: Food cost software for independent restaurants
Home.heroSubtitle: Recipe costing, live margins, and clean Excel exports — know the real cost of every dish in 15 minutes. No POS. No demo call.
Home.trustPropagation: Change one ingredient price → every affected recipe recalculated instantly.
Home.engineBody: When a supplier price moves, FoodCost recomputes every recipe and sub-recipe that uses that ingredient and flags any dish whose food cost % crosses your target — the one thing a spreadsheet can never do.
